title: Time-Spectral Resolvent Analysis For Periodic Dynamical Systems
summary: Traditional resolvent analysis is a powerful framework for identifying the most amplified input-output structures in fluid flows from a stationary base state. Extending this resolvent analysis to periodic base flows poses computational challenges due to quasi-periodic responses and expensive linearization around a time-varying base flow. This work proposes a time-spectral resolvent operator formulated using the time-spectral method and Fourier collocation that operates directly in the time domain.
